claims.title: Reciprocal photon scattering: certified parity compensation, passive resources and independent radiation limit

quoted_fields.interface: Declared finite band(0,2B), common omega envelope, equal conjugate directional contacts, tau*B=1.1,gamma=1 in source normalization, exact integral-defined calibration and both photon directions. The lossless bound uses chi=1800B per missing memory excitation. Capacity needs positive Schur form and positive K-conserving Dicke-null memory interaction. Independent-loss claims require the separately specified full-rank radiation continua.
quoted_fields.failure: Asymptotic stationary one-photon operation with arbitrary reference, not finite-time injection/capture/extraction or a hardware gate. No physical envelope/cutoff/contact calibration or measured independent loss supplied. General reciprocal dispersion preserves parity but requires new calibration and a new numeric band certificate. Three acquired companion programs import absent design/search files; their grids and residuals remain source reports. This different reciprocal Hamiltonian does not close N1026 missing chiral matrix-certificate support or the homogeneous Jacobi single-impurity capacity-two question.
